title: Augmenting Bias Detection in LLMs Using Topological Data Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a Wasserstein bias statistic using topological data analysis on GPT-2's self-attention heads to compare representations of stereotype, anti-stereotype, and irrelevant continuations from the StereoSet dataset.
